note: Rects are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in canvas pixels (2x). Divide by 2 for HUD pixels at scale 1. Draw order: hg_shadow, hg_shadow_glass, hg_glow (when shown), hg_glass_back, hg_sand_top_NN, hg_stream_N, hg_sand_bot_NN, hg_glow_inner (when shown), hg_glass_front, hg_crack_N, hg_frame, then the plate; after the strike: hg_shadow, hg_frame, hg_drop_NN, hg_shatter_NN (during the shatter) or hg_sand_spill, then the plate.

hg_shadow.png.note: soft drop shadow of the frame; draw first

hg_shadow_glass.png.note: soft drop shadow of the glass; draw after hg_shadow, hide after the strike

hg_glass_back.png.note: glass interior tint, behind the sand

hg_glass_front.png.note: glass highlights, rim light, Fresnel; over the sand

hg_frame.png.note: brass and bone frame with the maw medallions; over the glass

hg_stream_0.png.note: falling stream, frame 0 of 6 (loop); between the sand layers

hg_stream_1.png.note: falling stream, frame 1 of 6 (loop); between the sand layers
